statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent dizziness
These symptoms have persisted despite initial management for supraventricular tachycardia
A long-term continuous ECG monitoring study is indicated
The service was rendered under CPT code 93247
The diagnosis codes are I47.1 and R42
The denial reason code is PR-204
The service is medically necessary to evaluate documented cardiac rhythm disturbances
